note: Curated provider catalog shipped with the plugin. A remote catalog (same schema, served from a raw GitHub URL) can be added in Settings and overrides entries with matching ids. Model IDs change often — always verify against the provider's docs. Sign-up links support switchXprovider development.

providers.name: AgentRouter
providers.description: Community gateway with GLM, DeepSeek and Claude-family models behind one endpoint. Claude Code clients only — it fingerprints user-agents, which the proxy handles. Free models available.

providers.name: SeekAi
providers.description: Multi-model gateway with DeepSeek and Claude models. Watch for capacity hiccups under load — failover covers it.

providers.name: GoRouter
providers.description: Gateway focused on Claude-family models, including thinking variants. Cloudflare-fronted — expects Claude Code-shaped traffic.

providers.name: Bynara
providers.description: Gateway with a generous free tier — MiMo, DeepSeek and MiniMax free models make it a solid last-resort fallback.

providers.name: TabiToken
providers.description: Token-based gateway behind Cloudflare. Model IDs aren't public — check your dashboard after signing up and fill them in when adding.

providers.name: BlueSminds
providers.description: Anthropic-compatible gateway (new-api based). Model IDs aren't public — check your dashboard after signing up.

providers.name: B.AI
providers.description: Anthropic-compatible gateway. Model IDs aren't public — check your dashboard after signing up.

providers.name: APInex
providers.description: Anthropic-compatible gateway — "one API for every model". Free tier available. Model IDs aren't public — check your dashboard after signing up.

providers.name: OrcaRouter
providers.description: Gateway with 200+ models behind one API, incl. free Claude Opus/Sonnet slots and a free auto-router model (orcarouter/free). Anthropic endpoint supported.

providers.name: KiraAI
providers.description: Vietnamese gateway with free GLM-5.3, MiMo, Qwen and Kira models (daily free quota), plus paid partner models. Anthropic endpoint supported.

providers.name: TokenRouter
providers.description: Router with a free z-ai/glm-5.3-free model. ⚠ LIMITED-TIME free offering — the free tier may end without notice; treat it as a bonus lane, not a backbone. Anthropic endpoint supported.

providers.name: VyceAI
providers.description: API proxy for Claude, GPT, DeepSeek, Gemini and more — one key, multiple models. Anthropic endpoint supported. Model IDs from your dashboard after sign-up.

providers.name: OpenRouter
providers.description: The big model aggregator — hundreds of models behind one key, incl. a rotating pool of :free models (NVIDIA Nemotron Ultra, Ling, and more; the free pool changes, check the site). Anthropic endpoint supported.

providers.name: OpenCode Zen
providers.description: Gateway from the OpenCode project — Claude, GPT, Gemini, GLM, DeepSeek and more behind one key, with free models (Nemotron, DeepSeek, MiMo free tiers). Anthropic endpoint supported.

providers.name: Google AI Studio
providers.description: Google's Gemini API with a free daily quota (rate-limited, no credit card). OpenAI-protocol endpoint — the proxy translates automatically. Get a key at aistudio.google.com and verify current model IDs there.

providers.name: NVIDIA NIM
providers.description: NVIDIA's model catalog (Nemotron and partners) behind one key — free starter credits at sign-up. OpenAI-protocol endpoint — the proxy translates automatically. Verify current model IDs at build.nvidia.com.

providers.name: LLM7
providers.description: Free gateway with a generous daily quota — 1,000,000 tokens/day on a free token (500,000 anonymous). Free tier covers turbo models only (DeepSeek V4 Flash, Codestral); Claude/GPT/Gemini IDs are pro-tier and need a subscription. OpenAI-protocol endpoint — the proxy translates automatically. Model IDs rotate often — verify at api.llm7.io/v1/models.

providers.name: Agnes AI
providers.description: Singapore-based gateway for Agnes' own multimodal model family — text, image and video behind one key. Free tier with request quotas; agnes-2.5-flash (512K context, tools, vision, agent workflows) is the daily driver, pro models need a subscription. OpenAI-protocol endpoint — the proxy translates automatically. Verify quotas in the platform console.

providers.name: Groq
providers.description: LPU inference — open models (GPT-OSS, Qwen, Llama) at extreme speed. Free tier needs no credit card: rate-limited (~30 req/min, 1K req/day, 200K tokens/day on chat models), org-level limits. Llama 70B moved to Enterprise-only — GPT-OSS 120B is the workhorse now. OpenAI-protocol endpoint — the proxy translates automatically. Verify live model IDs at console.groq.com.
providers.pricing: free rate-limited tier + Developer plan (~10x limits)
